basic_profile.bio: I am a 34-year-old software engineer based in San Francisco, CA. I have a strong passion for technology and gaming, especially mobile and console gaming. I spend a lot of my free time tinkering with gadgets and exploring the latest in consumer tech. I’m also an automotive enthusiast with a keen interest in electric vehicles, particularly Tesla models. Most nights, you'll find me online after work hours, typically between 7 PM and midnight PST. I'm currently in a long-term relationship, and my partner shares my interest in tech and gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience working in tech companies. My expertise spans software development and mobile app optimization. I keep myself updated with the latest technology trends through online courses and tech forums.
